tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file from the filesystem. Use this when you need to view or analyze file contents.

path.description: Path to the file to read

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write content to a file on the filesystem. Use this to create new files or overwrite existing ones.

path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories in a given path. Useful for exploring directory structures.

path.description: Path to the directory to list

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files matching a pattern in a directory. Use glob patterns like '*.py' or '*.txt'.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get metadata information about a file including size, modified time, permissions, etc.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory at the specified path. Creates parent directories if needed.

path.description: Path where the directory should be created

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the filesystem. Use with caution as this operation cannot be undone.

path.description: Path to the file to delete

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file from one location to another.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy a file from one location to another, preserving the original.

source.description: Path of the file to copy

destination.description: Path where the copy should be created

tools.name: find_text_in_files
tools.description: Search for text content within files in a directory. Useful for finding specific code or text.

file_pattern.description: Optional file pattern to limit search (e.g., '*.py')
